verdict.rationale: Codex documentation itself is published as llms.txt/agent-oriented markdown (developers.openai.com/llms.txt returns 200 and indexes markdown docs), showing the product's own docs are agent-consumable, but there is no evidence that a Codex plugin/agent can be pointed at an arbitrary external llms.txt or agent-oriented docs site to ingest and act on it as a user-directed capability. missing for 10: explicit feature/skill letting a user supply/point the agent at a third-party llms.txt or docs URL for ingestion, and any hands-on confirmation of this workflow beyond the docs' own self-hosting.
